title: Neon Casino
tagline: A private casino night for friends: blackjack, roulette, Texas Hold'em, Teen Patti, slots and video poker on one shared wallet, in a 3D back room with bots and a soundtrack, with loans, bankruptcies and a final reckoning. Play money only.

roles.name: Player
roles.description: Host a room and share the 5-character code, or join one. Everyone starts with the same play-money wallet.

multiplayer.style: casino, server-authoritative, shared economy, room code
multiplayer.notes: Rooms run on the game's own Socket.io server (server/index.mjs, loaded by npm start). The server holds every wallet, the ledger, the decks and the wheel; browsers only send intents. Rooms are saved to server/data/ and survive a restart. Design: games/casino/docs/DESIGN.md.

requires: npm start (the server is the bank)
